surface_verification.justification: backend/CLI-only checks and verifiers (deploy rollback audit trail, deploy_checks reconciliation, changelog aggregator refusal) with no startable web/dev-server surface of their own; effective complexity is small (risk_recheck.json), so F0.5 is not mandatory. Verified via the unit test suite (F0) plus real CLI invocations against this repo's own artifacts (validate-deploy.py, rollback.py).

behaviors.behavior: an --ack-data-drift override of a flagged (drifted/unknown) stored-data report is refused without a written --override-reason, before any hosting call is made
every rollback.py invocation is durably recorded, including a pre-flight refusal such as an unreadable --profile
a failed liveness check (smoke_test.py --output) is reconciled against the latest phase_history[deploy] entry, fail-closed when EITHER side's timestamp is missing or unparseable
a manual (operator-requested) rollback only reads as "proves alive" when a LATER liveness check both post-dates it AND reports success:true
validate-deploy.py's test gate reads either shipwright_test_results.json producer shape (top-level or iterate_latest-nested) and treats E2E as non-blocking except on a reported partial failure
aggregate_changelog.py --fail-if-empty refuses to tag a version that was never released and has nothing pending, with an accurate refusal message

behaviors.reason: the confirmation is an interactive AskUserQuestion in the SKILL.md flow; only the proves-alive half (a later liveness check) leaves a durable artifact, which IS tested above. Downgraded to judgement in the AC-evidence ledger with this reasoning documented.
